XAUUSD 15m rejection sequence, stated in measured terms only.

1. On the 15m timeframe, the evaluated bar must have an upper wick of at
   least 0.60 of its own high-minus-low range.
2. The following 15m bar must close below the open of the bar in step 1.
3. The upper wick of that second bar must be at most 0.10 of its own
   high-minus-low range.
4. Evaluate on bar close only. The setup expires 4 bars after step 1.
5. Direction is SHORT throughout; the mirror case applies for LONG.
